paper_title: Adapting Whisper for Regional Dialects Enhancing Public Services for   Vulnerable Populations in the United Kingdom
caption: Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the differences in average Word Error Rate (WER) from a Whisper model across various optimizations applied to a task. The vertical axis represents the categories of optimisations applied, which are labeled as "Normalised," "Add Spacing," "Remove Spacing," "Americanisms," and "Dates." The order is listed top to bottom. The horizontal axis is the value axis labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large," featuring a linear scale ranging from 0.0000 to 0.0030 with tick intervals of 0.0010. Each optimization category contains two bars representing different models: the "NESAC ft model" in orange and the "SESHA ft model" in green, as noted by the legend. The values for the bars range from the shortest, "SESHA ft model" in the "Dates" category at 0.00228, to the tallest, "SESHA ft model" in the "Add Spacing" category at 0.00334. The bars are not sorted by height; rather, they follow a fixed categorical order. Each bar within a category is aligned side-by-side for comparison, but there is no specific emphasis or sorting applied to the order of presentation. A legend is placed at the bottom of the plot.
